validity.recommendation: Minor data-quality fix: OtherLanguagePrimaryPipelineName's first clause for P6684 ('Газопровод Северо-Соленинское – Южно-Соленинское – Мессояха, II нитка') drops the Pelyatka origin that its own second clause and P6683's matching field both carry -- align it to read 'Газопровод Пелятка - Северо-Соленинское – Южно-Соленинское – Мессояха, II нитка' for internal consistency. Not a route/endpoint error.
validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE + CLASSIFICATION: confirmed, same corroboration as P6683 (see that row's validity[] for the two independent sources: norilsktgaz.ru production page + RF decree 816-r item 340). NAMING CAVEAT flagged in the orchestrator brief: P6684's OtherLanguagePrimaryPipelineName has two clauses that disagree -- the first ('Газопровод Северо-Соленинское – Южно-Соленинское – Мессояха, II нитка') omits Pelyatka as the starting point, while the second ('магистральный газопровод УКПГ Пеляткинского ГКМ - УКПГ Мессояхского ГМ') includes it, and P6683's equivalent first clause also includes Pelyatka. Norilsktransgaz's own page settles it: 'Магистральный газопровод включает в себя участки Пелятка - Северо-Соленинское – Южно-Соленинское – Мессояха, имеющие по две нитки, расположенные параллельно' -- BOTH nitki (I and II) run the full Pelyatka-to-Messoyakha corridor; no evidence II starts anywhere but Pelyatka. Treating this as a data-entry inconsistency in the alt-name field, not a real endpoint/route difference -- StartLocation='Pelyatkinskoye Oil and Gas Field' on P6684 is correct as recorded.

Uses the Russian decimal comma '1,8'; the automated pre-check searched ASCII '1.80'/'1.8' and missed it -- hand-confirmed by reading the page.
